chunks: It is a tree that grows at the bottom of Hell.

key_terms.الْجَحِيمِ: Hell (specifically the lower part or root of Hell)

ai.seo_question: Where does the tree of Zaqqum grow according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the tree of Zaqqum is understood not merely as a physical entity but as a manifestation of the inner spiritual state of the wicked, reflecting the principle of *Tajalli al-A'mal* (the manifestation of deeds). Its origin at the root of *Jahim* underscores the deep-seated nature of their sins, serving as a tangible punishment that corresponds to their specific transgressions. This imagery reinforces the concept of the afterlife as a realm where spiritual realities become physically perceptible.
